title: Can AI have a mind of its own?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What would convince you that an AI had a mind rather than simply imitating human conversation?
Is intelligence enough for consciousness, or are they completely different things?
Should a highly advanced AI ever receive legal rights?
How could humans test for consciousness if we cannot directly observe another mind?
Would you feel morally uncomfortable switching off an AI that begged you not to?
